children: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. Central Command commander Cooper said Iran's crude oil exports are zero because of the blockade, more than 1 billion barrels of oil have passed through the Strait of Hormuz in recent months, and oil, cargo, and liquefied natural gas (LNG) volumes over the past two weeks hit a six-month high.

title: U.S. Central Command's Cooper Says Iran's Crude Oil Exports Are Zero Under Blockade
